# Unified AI System

> A terminal-first, self-hosted AI gateway and governed MCP server for Codex, Cursor, and Cline.

Unified AI System provides one governed boundary for models, agents, knowledge, workflows, and tools. The first verified path uses a local fake provider, requires no account or API key, and makes no real-provider calls.

## Prompt enhancement profiles

The provider-free deterministic enhancer preserves the original request and
adds a task-specific execution contract:

- `planning`: milestones, dependencies, risks, owners, and completion signals.
- `coding`: compatibility boundaries, error paths, runnable changes, and verification.
- `analysis`: comparison criteria, evidence, uncertainty, risks, and a next action.
- `writing`: audience, purpose, tone, structure, and a complete usable draft.
- `research`: source expectations, date scope, cross-checking, and uncertainty.
- `general`: ordered steps, practical structure, and direct coverage of the request.

Every preview reports `providerCalled=false`, `credentialRequired=false`, and
`deterministic=true`; real-provider execution is a separate explicitly
authorized path.

## Public distributions

- [Release v0.8.0](https://github.com/happy520ai/unified-ai-system/releases/tag/v0.8.0)
- [Official MCP Registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.happy520ai%2Funified-ai-system/versions/0.8.0)
- Agent Skill: `npx skills add happy520ai/unified-ai-system --skill unified-ai-gateway --agent codex --copy --yes`
- MCP container: `ghcr.io/happy520ai/unified-ai-system/mcp-server:0.8.0`
- Gateway demo container: `ghcr.io/happy520ai/unified-ai-system/ai-gateway-service:0.8.0`

## Verified boundaries

- The stable v0.8.0 MCP image and current source both expose fifteen tools, including provider-free prompt enhancement.
- Plain chat requests remain unchanged unless prompt enhancement is explicitly enabled.
- The credential-free default uses `local-fake-provider` in `fake` execution mode.
- Real-provider execution requires explicit, scoped authorization.
- Production readiness, L5 autonomy, and AGI require independent evidence.
- License: Apache-2.0.

- [Will an MCP server agree to a protocol version that does not exist? (7 of 14 answered 2025-11-25 to a nonsense request)](https://happy520ai.github.io/unified-ai-system/mcp-protocol-revision-tolerance.html)
- [If an MCP server hands you a session id, does it require it back? (measured per server, with the counter-examples named)](https://happy520ai.github.io/unified-ai-system/mcp-session-enforcement.html)
